reviews.review: Looks like someone picked up the Left 4 Dead 2 zombies moves and just changed the skin for some aggressive civilian aliens. But, its not so good as L4D2. The weapon upgrade system is good, but the game looks incomplete. While L4D2 has an scary environment, this one has 'no' environment. Its just kill aliens. I hope they launch a little bit more content, once it is in early access and they say that devs are a small team.
I've only carried Barry through one episode but if anything happens to him I will kill everyone in this room and myself.

An online review compared this to the "I'm not done yet though" meme and I couldn't put it in better words. The Anarusis clearly has a very good base, I and many others can see the potential to be an excellent game, even one that can beat B4B as L4D2's successor. However, many elements are still lacking that gives this game a very samey and something infuriating gameplay experience. 

[h1] The Good [/h1] 

What there is now is decently entertaining. I like the idea of the Matter Compiler as a game mechanic, more so than B4B's trading card system. Although it may encourage bad (and I mean bad-intention-ed, not bad skilled) players to focus on that rather than their teammates. It also has a good array of grenade types. The flasher is also a really cool concept and is very different from what we've seen so far in these type of games
Also many people praise the open workshop, something B4B does not have. I personally have not tried this but I do love workshop mods in games, 

[h1] The Bad [/h1]
Play this game if you're sick and tired of having high frame rate. Even the smallest of escalations can tank the framerate. The game also can go from having no enemies for miles to a complete storm on them in an instant. This wouldn't be a problem if it were not for the framerate issue, but maybe that's the genius of it and I'm just missing the point. 
The maps are also kinda samey and at times mazey. The mechanic showing you the way forwards might indicate to me that I'm not the only one confused by the maps. 
The bots in this game might also need an extra layer of jacket. I've watch them stand in fire and jump into the lava pit. I get that a spaceship with limited power can be cold, but surely they are better ways to warm up. I also saw Lance stand right in front of me gooed and missed everyone of his shots. L4D2 bots without guns are more helpful, and that's saying a lot. I would rather have the L4D2 bots make my screen have a magnitude 9 earthquake and Anacrusis bots shooting like Stormtroopers. 
Episode 4 is still very early in development. I even fell through the map, followed by a friendly stranger that joined later and fell through a different part. 

[h1] Conclusion [/h1] 
Too early for an early access methinks
Bang bang shooty aliens much fun

Excellent take on the L4D type 4-player FPS co-op. 

Pros: The 70s retro art, music and stylings make every run bright and energetically frenetic. The level design is cleverly put together and endlessly replayable. Versus finally allows you to screw over your friends just the right amount, like you're meant to do in a co-op. 

Cons: 18 months and they still haven't fixed the "Grendade" typo when someone spots a grenade.

Every update adds new fun, highly recommend buying and following along where the devs go with it.
reviews.developer_response: We fixed the "Grendade" typo in Update 48. We said we'd get there eventually and we did.
